title: Torch
summary: TORCH, noun [Latin torqueo, tortus.] A light or luminary formed of some combustible substance, as of resinous wood or of candles. They light the nuptial torch

inlines.v: TORCH, noun [Latin torqueo, tortus.] A light or luminary formed of some combustible substance, as of resinous wood or of candles. They light the nuptial torch
